title: Ken: a match on the roof

cues.text: The dorm rooftop, beside the garden beds. Ken stands facing you, holding a long broom upright.
Ken holds out a toy plastic bat, and you take it. He grips his broom like a spear.

Ken charges at you, and the two of you spar. When it is over, Ken sits on the ground against a wall, legs stretched out, his broom fallen beside him and the toy bat lying on the floor, while you stand over him.
